About this group
Welcome to MN MINIS! 📸
MN MINIS is a community space designed to connect Minnesota photographers with people looking to book mini sessions. Whether you’re a photographer announcing upcoming minis or someone searching for the perfect quick photo session, this group makes it easy to find and share opportunities all in one place.
Mini sessions are short, themed photo sessions that are typically offered on specific dates and at a special rate. They’re perfect for families, couples, seniors, maternity, branding photos, seasonal photos, and more.
This group is for:
✨ Photographers who want to promote upcoming mini sessions in Minnesota
✨ Clients looking to book mini sessions with local photographers
✨ Anyone searching for seasonal photo opportunities like fall, holiday, spring, tulips, cap & gown, Mother’s Day, and more
For Photographers:
When posting your mini sessions, please include helpful details such as:
• Date(s) and location
• Theme or setting
• Number of images included
• Session length
• Price
• Booking link or contact information
• A sample photo if available
You may also post when you are looking to fill last-minute openings or announce newly released mini sessions.
For Clients:
Feel free to:
✔ Ask for photographer recommendations
✔ Post what type of session you’re looking for (family, senior, maternity, etc.)
✔ Share preferred location or timeframe
✔ Ask questions about mini sessions
Photographers can then comment or connect with you directly.
Group Guidelines:
• Be kind and respectful to everyone in the community
• No spam or unrelated promotions
• Photographers: please only post mini sessions or photography-related content
• Clients: no ISO posts for services unrelated to photography
• Do not copy or steal another photographer’s work or images
Admins may remove posts that do not follow the guidelines. See less

Group rules from the admin
Be kind and courteous
We're all in this together to create a Welcoming environment. Let's treat everyone with respect. Healthy debates are natural, but kindness is required.
No hate speech or bullying
Make sure everyone feels safe. Bullying of any kind isn't allowed, and degrading comments about things like race, religion, culture, sexual orientation, gender or identity will not be tolerated.
Mini Sessions Only
This group is specifically for mini sessions offered in Minnesota. Photographers may promote mini sessions, themed events, and limited-time session offerings. Full session promotions, general advertising, or unrelated services are not allowed.
Include Important Details in Your Post
Photographers must include the following when posting minis: • Date(s) • Location (city or general area) • Session theme or setup • Price • What is included (number of images, session length, etc.) • Booking link or contact information Posts missing key details may be removed.
Minnesota-Based Sessions Only
All mini sessions posted must take place in Minnesota or very close to the MN border.
Client ISO Posts Are Welcome
Clients may post when they are looking for a specific type of mini session (family, maternity, senior, etc.). Photographers may comment on those posts, but please avoid spamming.
Limit Reposting
Photographers may repost the same mini session once every 7 days to avoid flooding the feed.
No Unsolicited Messages to Potential Clients
Photographers may not privately message, DM, or otherwise contact potential clients based on their posts or activity in this group unless the client has specifically invited them to do so. If a potential client makes a post looking for a photographer, you are welcome to comment on their post with your information, portfolio, pricing, or availability. Please allow the client to decide who they would like to contact. Unsolicited messages may result in a warning or removal from the group.
